### Source: doc_savings_accounts_bronze_account_001
**Bronze Savings Account: Complete Guide**

## Key rates and fees

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Annual Percentage Yield (APY) | 2.0% |
| Monthly maintenance fee | $0.00 |
| Minimum opening deposit | $0 |

## Opening your account
- Fund your account with at least $0.
- You can add funds immediately after the account is opened.

## Earning interest
- You earn interest at an APY of 2.0% on your balance.
- Interest accrues automatically once your account is funded; no additional action is required.

## Fees
- The monthly maintenance fee is $0.00. If this value is $0, no monthly maintenance fee will be charged.

## Practical tips
- Keep the account funded to consistently earn 2.0% APY.
- Review your statements to confirm posted interest and any fees.

**Bronze Account specifications and requirements**

## Balance and opening requirements
- Minimum balance requirement: $0
- Minimum opening deposit: $0

## Interest processing
- Interest compounding frequency: daily

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_bronze_account_004
**How to avoid monthly fees**

## No monthly maintenance fee
Great news! The Bronze Savings Account has no monthly maintenance fee. The monthly maintenance fee is $0.00 and the minimum balance requirement is 0. Unlike other savings accounts that require minimum balances to waive fees, the Bronze Account is completely fee-free for monthly maintenance. You will never be charged a monthly maintenance fee on this account, regardless of your balance. This makes it an ideal starter savings account for customers who want to begin saving without worrying about maintaining a minimum balance.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_bronze_account_005
**Why am I being charged a fee on my Bronze Account?**

## First, rule out monthly maintenance fees
- The Bronze Savings Account has a monthly maintenance fee of $0.00 and a minimum balance requirement of $0. If the monthly maintenance fee is $0, you will not be charged a monthly maintenance fee, regardless of your balance.

## Common reasons you may see a fee
- Excess withdrawal activity: After 6 withdrawals in a monthly cycle, each additional withdrawal may incur an excess withdrawal fee of $3.00.
- Paper statement delivery: If you are enrolled in paper statements, a paper statement fee of $2.00 may apply each month you receive a paper statement.

## How to verify the fee
- Review your recent transactions and look for line items labeled as excess withdrawal fees or paper statement fees.
- Count the number of withdrawals in your current cycle to see if you exceeded 6.
- Check your statement delivery preference; switch to digital statements to avoid the $2.00 paper statement fee.

## If you still have questions
- Compare the fee description on your statement with the categories above.
- Contact support with the transaction date and description for clarification on the specific charge.

---

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_bronze_account_006
**Bronze Account: Why did my interest rate change?**

## What can cause changes you notice
- Rate updates: Your account earns interest at the current APY. When the APY changes, your earnings adjust accordingly.
- Compounding effects: Because interest compounds daily, the amount of interest credited can vary with day count and balance changes even if the APY is unchanged.
- Credit card relationships: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides APY bonuses. If you hold a Platinum Rewards Card, you receive an additional +0.55% APY bonus. Diamond Elite Card holders receive +0.15% bonus.

## How to confirm your current APY
- Check your account details to view the currently applicable APY. If the current APY is listed as 2.0%, interest will accrue at that rate until it changes.

## Troubleshooting perceived changes
- Compare the APY shown in your account today with prior statements to see if a rate update occurred.
- Consider whether your average daily balance changed, which affects the interest dollar amount even at the same APY.

## Need more help?
- If the posted APY or credited interest does not match expectations, note the statement period and contact support for a review.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_bronze_account_007
**Bronze Account: Getting interest payments**

## How your interest accrues
- Interest compounds daily, so each day's interest is based on your current balance plus any previously accrued interest.

## When you receive interest
- Interest is credited monthly. You will see a single interest credit entry for each crediting period.

## What you will see on your statement
- A transaction line item showing the net interest credited for the period.
- The APY in effect for the period, such as 2.0%, as reflected in your account disclosures.

## Credit card APY bonuses
- Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Bronze Account:
  - Bronze Rewards Card: +0.1%
  - Silver Rewards Card: +0%
  - Gold Rewards Card: +0.25%
  - EcoCard: +0%
  - Green Rewards Card: +0.2%
  - Crypto-Cash Back Card: +0.3%

## Tips for verifying interest
- Compare the interest credit to your balance history for the period; fluctuations in balance will affect the credited amount.
- If you opened the account mid-period, the first interest credit will reflect only the days the account was open.

## Where to find the entries
- Review your transaction history for the interest credit posted monthly.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_bronze_account_008
**Bronze Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits**

## Mobile check deposit
- Daily mobile check deposit limit: $1,000.
- If you reach the daily limit, you can submit additional deposits on the next day when the limit resets.

## Transfers in the mobile app
- Maximum total amount you can transfer out per day: $2,500.

## Tips for smooth processing
- Plan larger deposits or transfers over multiple days if the amount exceeds your daily limits.
- Submit deposits and transfers as early as possible during the day to allow time for review and posting.

## How to check your remaining limit
- Attempt to initiate a deposit or transfer; the app will alert you if the request exceeds $1,000 for mobile deposits or $2,500 for transfers.

---

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_bronze_account_009
**Transferring funds to external banks: Bronze Accounts**

## Processing time
- Standard external transfers typically complete in 3 business days from the date they begin processing.

## Daily transfer limit
- You can transfer out up to $2,500 per day to external banks.

## Scheduling guidance
- Transfers set up on non-business days will begin processing on the next business day.
- For time-sensitive moves, schedule early and account for the 3-business-day window.

## Tracking your transfer
- Check your transfer activity for status updates (scheduled, in process, or completed).
- If a transfer exceeds $2,500, split it across multiple days to stay within the daily limit.
